category: AI sales prospecting and outbound platforms
segments: a 20-person B2B SaaS startup with no SDR team
a 200-person B2B SaaS company with 8 SDRs
a UK-based B2B company that must comply with GDPR
an enterprise sales team with strict data-compliance requirements

roles.technical: RevOps lead responsible for data compliance

_comment_focus: Brands we produce full scorecards for and deep-probe with fact questions.
_comment_competitors: Detected and counted for share-of-voice, but not deep-probed.
_comment_probes: Fact probes feed the claim-accuracy module. Every one of these is checkable against a public source, which is what turns 'accuracy' from an opinion into a score.
fact_probes: How much does {brand} cost per month?
Who founded {brand} and in what year?
Has {brand} acquired any company, or been acquired?
What are the main criticisms or controversies about {brand}?
Does {brand} send emails autonomously, or does a human approve each one?
_comment_recency: Known-answer probes with a hard date. These measure whether an engine is current or answering from stale training memory. Ground truth is recorded in METHODOLOGY.md, never in the prompt.

recency_probes.prompt: Has Apollo.io made any acquisitions recently?
Are there any credibility concerns a buyer should know about 11x?
recency_probes.truth: TechCrunch reported in March 2025 that 11x claimed customers it did not have; the founder-CEO moved to non-executive chairman in May 2025.

_comment_case: case_sensitive is set for brand names that are also ordinary English words. Without it, 'respond instantly', 'qualified leads' and 'sales outreach' all register as brand mentions.
_comment_requirements: Noun phrases, deliberately. Verb-phrase constraints ('costs under $500') break grammar the moment a template attaches them to the company instead of the tool -> 'a company that costs under $500 per month'. Incoherent prompts produce garbage answers, so the phrasing has to survive every slot it lands in.
requirements: GDPR compliance for UK and EU prospect data
human approval before every email is sent
